nodes.klein: to spring, jump. he bounded, rebounded, recoiled, shrank; he was disgusted. he sprang, jumped (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 6:10 in the form אֲסַלְּדָה, ‘I would spring’); tr. v. he extolled, praised (according to another interpretation of אֲסַלְּדָה). he caused to shrink from, startled.
